Footer.statement: Technology to run operations better, built in Tijuana.

Home.heroLead: We connect your processes and your data so every decision runs on what is happening now, not on yesterday’s report.

manufactura.name: Manufacturing
manufactura.measure: Every line stop, with its cause and its cost, the moment it happens.

logistica.name: Logistics
logistica.measure: Every trailer in the yard and every dock door, timed as it moves.

construccion.name: Construction
construccion.measure: Site progress and field equipment, without waiting for the weekly report.

agroindustria.name: Agribusiness
agroindustria.measure: Each tunnel’s soil moisture drives irrigation, not the calendar.

energia.name: Energy
energia.measure: Output and alarms from every asset, on a single dashboard.

Manifesto.label: Who we are
Manifesto.text: We are an engineering team in Tijuana. We connect your machines to your systems so <line>data</line> reaches the people who decide in <clock>real time</clock>. No spreadsheets that contradict each other, no reports that arrive late: your <bars>processes</bars>, visible and measured.

industries.label: Industries
industries.value: Manufacturing, logistics, construction, agribusiness, energy, retail and corporate

connect.label: We connect
connect.value: Sensors, PLCs, ERPs, spreadsheets and the apps you already use

deliver.label: We deliver
deliver.value: Real-time dashboards, web and mobile apps, and custom software

Signal.title: How we do it.
Signal.lead: A short chain between what happens on the floor and whoever decides, with nobody copying data by hand.

signal.name: Signal
signal.text: Sensors and PLCs read what happens at the machine, the tank or the field.

integration.name: Integration
integration.text: That reading joins your ERP, your spreadsheets and your apps in a single source.

dashboard.name: Dashboard
dashboard.text: Everyone sees what matters to them, as it happens, on the line screen or on their phone.

alert.name: Alert
alert.text: When something goes out of range, it notifies whoever must act, not everyone.

action.name: Action
action.text: The decision is logged and the process adjusts; what happened becomes an improvement.

Services.title: What we build.
Services.lead: Eight capabilities that combine to fit your operation. You almost never need to start with all of them.

dashboards.name: Dashboards and visualization
dashboards.text: Your operation’s indicators live: output, downtime, consumption and progress.

apps.name: Web and mobile apps
apps.text: Tools for your team on the floor and in the field, online or offline.

telemetry.name: Industrial telemetry
telemetry.text: Connected sensors and PLCs that report on their own, no manual entry.

integration.name: Systems integration
integration.text: Your ERP, your machines and your spreadsheets speaking the same language.

automation.name: Process automation
automation.text: Rules that start, stop and alert without waiting for someone to notice.

analytics.name: Data analysis
analytics.text: From records to answers: where time, material and money are lost.

custom.name: Custom software
custom.text: When nothing on the market fits how you work, we build it.

support.name: Support and maintenance
support.text: We stay with you after delivery: monitoring, adjustments and improvements.

Process.title: From stroke to data.
Process.lead: An instrumented pumping station. Whatever happens on the line arrives as data in real time, and the control acts on it.
Process.diagram: Station diagram: TK-100 cistern, P-101 pump, FIT-101 flowmeter, XV-101 valve, PIT-101 pressure transmitter and the TK-101 elevated tank with its LIT-101 level transmitter.

cta.lead: The same, with your equipment and your data.

intro.title: Technology for operations, from the Pacific.
intro.lead: We are Sistemas Inteligentes del Pacífico, founded in 2026 in Tijuana, Baja California. The Pacific is in our name because this is where we are: close to the plants, warehouses and teams we work for.

who.title: A young company that brings three trades together.
who.text: Programming, data analysis and industrial know-how rarely sit on the same team. At SIP they do, so an idea born in your operation leaves here as a tool your people use every day.

vision.name: Vision
vision.text: To be the reference in Mexico when an operation needs technology that truly solves the problem: simple to use and designed for the people who run it.

mission.name: Mission
mission.text: To help every operation produce more and grow, with digital systems that work every day and grow along with it.

commitments.title: What you can expect from us.

fit.name: Built around you
fit.text: We start from how your operation works, not from a package, and what we build grows as you add lines or sites.

results.name: Results you can measure
results.text: Before we start, we agree on which number has to change, whether it’s downtime, picking time or energy use, and we measure it after delivery.

direct.name: Direct contact
direct.text: You talk to the people who design and build your system, and the same team supports it after delivery. We look for long relationships, not one-off projects.

lasting.name: Technology that lasts
lasting.text: We use the newest tools when they solve something and proven ones when the operation can’t stop. Every release improves what already works.

Contact.title: Let’s make your idea big.
Contact.lead: Tell us what is happening in your operation and what you would like to see in real time. The team that will build it is the one that answers.
